simple.summary: רָזֶה (râzeh) means thin First listed occurrence: Ezek 34 20.

definitions.full: H7330. razeh [ רָזֶה ] adjective lean (on formation compare Lag BN 49 ); — feminine singular רָזָה , Ezek 24:20 (of שֶׂה ; opposed to בִּרְיָה ), of land, = barren, Num 13:20 (J E; opposed to שְׁמֵנָה ).
